l4_steps.name: Capture Property Irregularity Report at arrival hall
l4_steps.input: Passenger complaint at baggage claim; flight arrival manifest
l4_steps.output: PIR reference number; AHL (mishandled bag) file opened in WorldTracer
l4_steps.kpi: PIR captured within 20 min of carousel clearance ≥98%
l4_steps.pain_point: High passenger volumes at hub airports cause PIR queue backlogs; agents default to paper forms that delay WorldTracer entry by 2–4 hrs

l4_steps.name: Verify PNR and bag tag details in Altéa
l4_steps.input: Passenger boarding pass or booking reference; PIR form
l4_steps.output: Confirmed bag tag number(s), itinerary, and contact details linked to PIR
l4_steps.kpi: PNR match rate ≥99.5%; missing bag tag resolved via passenger description within 15 min
l4_steps.pain_point: Passengers without digital boarding passes cannot self-serve via kiosk; paper bag tags occasionally unreadable after sortation damage

l4_steps.name: Search local carousel, offload area, and left baggage
l4_steps.input: Bag tag number; flight load manifest from BRS
l4_steps.output: Physical search result; BagManager scan log confirming whether bag was offloaded locally
l4_steps.kpi: Local recovery rate ≥35% within 30 min of PIR opening
l4_steps.pain_point: BagManager scan coverage gaps at outstations mean bags offloaded to wrong belt go undetected until next carousel audit

l4_steps.name: Assess local scan log — bag present at station?
l4_steps.input: BRS sortation scan history for bag tag
l4_steps.output: Decision: bag located locally (return immediately) or escalate to WorldTracer trace
l4_steps.kpi: Same-day resolution for locally present bags ≥95%
l4_steps.pain_point: BRS scan logs not always synchronised with WorldTracer in real time; 5–10 min latency causes duplicate PIRs

l4_steps.name: Create AHL/OHD/DPR tracing message in WorldTracer
l4_steps.input: PIR reference; confirmed bag tag, description, and itinerary
l4_steps.output: WorldTracer AHL file broadcast to all stations on itinerary; OHD files requested from origin and transit stations
l4_steps.kpi: AHL file created within 2 hrs of PIR ≥99%; OHD response from partner stations ≤4 hrs
l4_steps.pain_point: Interline itineraries with non-Altéa carriers require manual telex; SITA messaging delays to some outstations exceed 30 min

l4_steps.name: Query BRS scan history for last known bag location
l4_steps.input: Bag tag number; WorldTracer AHL reference
l4_steps.output: Chronological scan event log identifying last confirmed airport and handler
l4_steps.kpi: Last-scan data available within 5 min for ≥95% of bags with electronic tags
l4_steps.pain_point: RFID read rates vary by airport — legacy barcode-only stations provide no scan after check-in, forcing inference from load messages

l4_steps.name: Evaluate WorldTracer match within 24-hour window
l4_steps.input: AHL file; incoming OHD and FWD messages; BagJourney scan log
l4_steps.output: Match confirmed or escalation to manual canvass; WorldTracer case status updated
l4_steps.kpi: First match rate within 24 hrs ≥72% (IATA Resolution 743 target); escalation triggered <28%
l4_steps.pain_point: WorldTracer automatic matching fails when bag description is vague or bag tag damaged; human review adds 2–6 hr lag at high-volume stations

l4_steps.name: Send FWD message to station holding located bag
l4_steps.input: Confirmed bag location from WorldTracer OHD/match; passenger delivery address
l4_steps.output: FWD telex dispatched; holding station instructed to ship bag on next available service
l4_steps.kpi: FWD message sent within 30 min of match confirmation ≥98%
l4_steps.pain_point: Ground handler contracts at some outstations do not include expedite forwarding; next available flight may be 24–48 hrs away

l4_steps.name: Confirm bag shipped and track via BagJourney
l4_steps.input: FWD message acknowledgment; airway bill or rush tag number
l4_steps.output: Real-time shipment tracking record; passenger notified of estimated arrival
l4_steps.kpi: Forward shipment confirmed (scan at origin) within 4 hrs of FWD message ≥90%
l4_steps.pain_point: Rush tags issued at outstations not always scanned into BagJourney, causing blind spots until arrival at destination

l4_steps.name: Receive forwarded bag at destination and verify condition
l4_steps.input: Inbound bag with rush tag; WorldTracer FWD reference
l4_steps.output: Bag receipt confirmed in BagManager; condition noted; WorldTracer status updated to RFL (ready for delivery)
l4_steps.kpi: Bag condition documented at receipt ≥99%; damaged bags flagged for claims within 1 hr
l4_steps.pain_point: Damaged-in-transit bags generate secondary claims that delay closure; handler liability ambiguity between origin and transit stations

l4_steps.name: Contact passenger to confirm delivery preference
l4_steps.input: Passenger contact details from PNR; bag RFL status in WorldTracer
l4_steps.output: Confirmed delivery address or airport pickup slot; passenger notified via SMS/email
l4_steps.kpi: Passenger contacted within 1 hr of RFL status ≥95%; delivery preference captured ≥98%
l4_steps.pain_point: Passenger contact data in PNR frequently outdated for connecting itineraries; GDPR constraints limit use of third-party contact enrichment

l4_steps.name: Schedule courier delivery via third-party delivery API
l4_steps.input: Passenger delivery address; bag dimensions and weight; service SLA
l4_steps.output: Courier booking confirmation; tracking number shared with passenger
l4_steps.kpi: Courier dispatched within 2 hrs of passenger confirmation ≥92%; delivery within 24 hrs of dispatch ≥85%
l4_steps.pain_point: Courier API integrations vary by country — some stations revert to manual phone booking, introducing 3–5 hr delays and no tracking visibility

l4_steps.name: Confirm delivery and obtain proof of receipt
l4_steps.input: Courier delivery confirmation or passenger airport pickup signature
l4_steps.output: Proof of delivery (POD) attached to WorldTracer file; file status updated to CLO (closed)
l4_steps.kpi: POD captured and attached to WorldTracer within 24 hrs of delivery ≥99%; WorldTracer file closed within 48 hrs of delivery
l4_steps.pain_point: Paper POD at outstations not digitised, leaving WorldTracer files open and inflating delayed-bag statistics for IATA reporting

l4_steps.name: Assess interim expense claim under Montreal Convention
l4_steps.input: Passenger expense receipts; days without bag; Montreal Convention Article 19 liability schedule
l4_steps.output: Approved interim expense amount (capped at 1,288 SDR); claim reference created in SAP
l4_steps.kpi: Interim claim assessed within 48 hrs of PIR ≥90%; average claim processing time ≤5 business days
l4_steps.pain_point: SDR-to-local-currency conversion rate must be applied at date of loss, not payment date — manual FX lookup creates errors in SAP FI journal entries

l4_steps.name: Process approved compensation payment via SAP Finance
l4_steps.input: Approved claim amount; passenger bank/card details; SAP vendor master record
l4_steps.output: Payment processed; remittance advice sent to passenger; WorldTracer file updated with settlement amount
l4_steps.kpi: Payment executed within 7 business days of approval ≥95%; zero unapproved payments exceeding liability cap
l4_steps.pain_point: Payments to international passengers require SWIFT transfers through SAP AP — SWIFT processing adds 3–5 business days in some corridors

l4_steps.name: Transfer unmatched bag to lost baggage storage at day 5
l4_steps.input: WorldTracer AHL file with no match after 5-day active trace; physical bag in holding area
l4_steps.output: WorldTracer status changed to STO (storage); bag catalogued with photo in WorldTracer Found Bag module
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of unmatched bags transferred to STO status by day 5; storage catalogue photo quality ≥95% usable
l4_steps.pain_point: Storage space at busy hubs is finite — airlines pay third-party warehouse fees after 10 days; uncatalogued bags cannot be matched to late-reporting passengers

l4_steps.name: Conduct extended 21-day owner identification search
l4_steps.input: STO bag record; WorldTracer auto-match; passenger-initiated trace enquiries
l4_steps.output: Owner identified and reunited (return to step 3.1) or case escalated to unclaimed disposal
l4_steps.kpi: Overall bag reunification rate within 21 days ≥97% (IATA Baggage Report benchmark); unclaimed rate <3%
l4_steps.pain_point: Passengers who do not file a PIR at the airport cannot initiate a WorldTracer search online without the original PIR reference — prevents late claims

l4_steps.name: Dispose of unclaimed bag per property regulation
l4_steps.input: Unclaimed STO bag at day 22+; local unclaimed property legislation requirements
l4_steps.output: Bag disposed (donated, auctioned, or destroyed) per local law; WorldTracer file closed with disposal notation
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of disposed bags documented with disposal method and date; zero regulatory non-compliance events
l4_steps.pain_point: Unclaimed property laws vary by country — US DOT, EU Regulation 889/2002, and individual state statutes create inconsistent disposal timelines and donation requirements
